_comment: Mississippi 2026 QAP Section 4, the five Threshold Factors (pp.23-26). Addendum B design standards, Addendum C required documents and the Section 5 underwriting criteria are incorporated elsewhere and not itemised.

criteria.heading: Local Zoning and Development Conditions
criteria.quote: The proposed development must be properly zoned for its intended use.

criteria.heading: Market Study

criteria.heading: Development Financing
criteria.quote: The Applicant must demonstrate sufficient funding sources for the completion of the proposed development.
